events.text:
A closed box whose top cover passes a cable — a compact phone charging station.

**Build:** single full hex cell `piece:0,0,0;full` with `cover:0,0,0;full;top` set to type `cable` (cable-entry cover), `cover:0,0,0;full;bottom` closing the underside, and 6 solid end caps on all side faces (`cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330`) via `capOpenFaces`, joints locked. Staged with phone prop on top deck to show use.

Check: `check_build` ok, meshClash clear, no open faces.

Claim only what is visible: shape provides an enclosed volume with cable entry through the top cover; no claims about electrical safety, waterproofing, or material suitability — those are unmet as the parts are 3D-printed plastic and configurator checks fit only.

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Closed box | met | One cell enclosed on all 6 side faces by solid caps + top cable cover + bottom cover: `cover:0,0,0;full;top` (cable), `cover:0,0,0;full;bottom`, 6x `cap:solid` |
| Cover that lets a cable pass through | met | Top cover type set to `cable` (`setCoverType` cable) — provides cable pass-throughs/glands in the top lid for charging cable, as visible on `cover:0,0,0;full;top` |

All configurator checks pass; prop visible in view.
